answer: An attacker running 99 aliases therefore needs 148 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in willow, expire in ember, and lagoon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4895 identities would post 3118 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
